analysis.method: Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) with Periodic Fourier Features
analysis.solver_or_optimizer: Hybrid Adam and SSBroyden (Self-Scaling Broyden/BFGS) quasi-Newton optimizer
analysis.enhancements: vRBA (Residual-Based Attention) with exponential potential, Importance Sampling based on residual magnitudes, Periodic Fourier Feature embedding, Gradient-based loss weighting (Adaptive lamB), Exponential Moving Average (EMA) for weight updates, Automatic differentiation via JAX (jvp/hvp)
analysis.BCs: Periodic Boundary Conditions enforced via Fourier embedding; Initial Conditions enforced via penalty term in the loss function
analysis.description: This implementation solves the Allen-Cahn equation using a PINN enhanced by a hybrid first/second-order optimization scheme and adaptive residual-based attention. It employs periodic embeddings to satisfy spatial boundary conditions and importance sampling to prioritize training on regions with high PDE residuals.
